upstreams.name: mac-custom
upstreams._note: Self-hosted OpenCode LLM on the user's Mac. Canonical daily E2E model ID: ag/gemini-3.6-flash-low. The router matches model IDs exactly, so DSH must request this exact ID (via E2E_LLM_MODEL) to reach mac-custom. No provider quota. Not a real-provider-compat proxy: no geminiThoughtSignatures here (different protocol).

upstreams.name: gemini-openai
upstreams._note: gemini-2.5-flash retired for new users (provider 404 2026-09-15 names gemini-3.6-flash as replacement). ROLE: real-provider compatibility verify (thought_signature etc.) before production — free tier RPD=20, do NOT use for daily dev (mac-custom covers that).
